name: MVPBlocks
tagline: Open-source UI blocks for shipping MVPs fast
description: Copy-paste sections aimed specifically at the SaaS-landing-page-in-a-weekend use case: pricing, hero, testimonial and auth blocks built with Next.js, Tailwind and Framer Motion, v0-compatible for further editing. Comes up repeatedly in roundups of shadcn-based libraries alongside Magic UI and Kibo UI.

best.title: MVPBlocks
best.note: Trending blocks gallery, CLI and manual install both supported.
